Subject: New signup — exploring embeddings for search & recs (ShopNova)

Hi Karthik,

We just signed up for the self-serve tier and I'd like to get a quick demo of Redwood's embeddings + reranking flow. High-level: we run search and product recommendations for ShopNova (ecommerce) and want to replace an in-house vector search pipeline.

A few quick context points:
- Use case: site search + personalized product recs for logged-in users
- Traffic: rough peak ~1M queries/day, avg 800k/day; exploratory readouts attached
- Timeline: pilot by Q4 (internal approval in 3–4 weeks)

Can we set up a 30-min call next week to walk through capabilities and what a pilot looks like? Happy to share our traffic export.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Head of Search, ShopNova
Attachment: signup-details.csv (CSV)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T08:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New signup — exploring embeddings for search & recs (ShopNova)

Thanks for reaching out, Sarah — congrats on signing up. Monica (cc'd) is our SDR; we'll coordinate the calendar once we confirm a few quick fit details so the demo covers the right parts of the product.

Two quick clarifying questions before we lock a slot:
1) For the 1M peak queries/day number, is that primarily search queries (user text input) or a mix of search + background ranking calls? A ballpark split would help (e.g., 70% search, 30% ranking).
2) Typical query size: average token count per query and average returned candidates per request (top-k).
3) Pilot success metric and timeline: is the pilot to validate latency/cost, quality lift, or both? And when do you want to start the pilot?
4) Data residency / SSO needs for pilot: do you need an invite-only pilot behind Okta or can we use hosted flow?

If it's easier, I can propose three 30-min slots after you reply. Also sending over a short pre-demo checklist to make the session productive.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0129

Hi Karthik — answers below, thanks.

On 2026-09-05 08:52, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Two quick clarifying questions before we lock a slot:

1) Split: roughly 85% user search queries, 15% background ranking / batch re-rank.
2) Query size: median ~18 tokens, 95th percentile ~60 tokens. Returned candidates: usually top-10 in the ranking call, search returns top-6 on product pages.
3) Pilot goals: both — primary goal is quality lift on search (measured by NDCG on a labeled set) and we need to ensure cost is within our allocation. Target start: mid-October (internal approvals by end of September).
4) Data residency: no special requirements for pilot. SSO: not required for the pilot.

I've attached a small sample of traffic (anonymized). If you can send 3 proposed slots for a 30-min call next week that would be great.

Thanks,
Sarah
